user_scope: Clear faithful shared community repository ASAP; no full-budget requirement or exhaustive experiments; stop unneeded jobs; push to GitHub when finished.
supersedes: Previous complete-benchmark and multi-seed performance release gates, including the reduced-budget study gate.
required: Explicit mapping of core mechanisms to readable code.
Document equation/implementation corrections and optional extensions.
Pass full existing correctness suite and installed-package/console/replay checks.
Keep supported simulator protocols and tested environment versions documented.
Provide short runnable examples with no optional native engine dependency.
Retain successful,failed and interrupted evidence; do not claim unverified performance.
Stop research sweeps and preserve the unrelated reproduction.
Push the verified repository to the user-specified GitHub destination.
not_required: Above-paper performance as a public-code release gate
remaining: History-preserving GitHub push and remote-tree verification
